io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/officia.statusMessage: Retired 2026-08-24; the endpoint now returns 410 with a pointer. Correcting the earlier note: "returns 404" was a misdiagnosis — a GET against a POST-only handler. POST tools/list returned 200: it was answering, not down. It was retired for what it served: a paper DOI as the dataset DOI, a v2-era count (65729 vs 65520), a legacy host, a signed-claim path never wired, and upstream errors dressed as audits. Use io.github.ogasurfproject-jpg/horizon-shield. Corrected, not erased.
